scope: Source research/acquisition. Original digital files are not automatically curator-approved.
criticalNotes: Prayer and 1962 observed date map to exact canonical subject keys; date title strings are not evidence.
The nine categories are not a claim of 365-day liturgical source correspondence; output mapping needs independent observed-calendar validation.
Station paintings often depict overlapping Passion events. Related composition is acceptable only with precise caption and explicit relationship.
Historically authenticated portrait is a separate gate from traditional painted saint iconography; St Pius X, Pope Leo XIII etc need verifiable original likeness.
The optional Luminous Rosary set is supplementary; the 15 traditional mysteries own the default.
Source acquisitions accept official CC0 or well documented PD-Art held separately pending worldwide commercial reuse assessment.
Arts reviews and phone crops are entirely deferred, per user request.
